public import NLA.MD06.CycleProfile.Roots

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace Reference.MD06CycleProfile
open scoped BigOperators
open Set

theorem actual_arcsin_scale_le {t a : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1)
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha1 : a ≤ 1) :
    Real.arcsin (a * t) ≤ a * Real.arcsin t := by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ Real.arcsin t := Real.arcsin_nonneg.mpr ht0
  have hu1 : Real.arcsin t ≤ Real.pi := by
    linarith [Real.arcsin_le_pi_div_two t, Real.pi_pos]
  have hs : (1-a) * Real.sin 0 + a * Real.sin (Real.arcsin t) ≤
      Real.sin ((1-a) * 0 + a * Real.arcsin t) :=
    strictConcaveOn_sin_Icc.concaveOn.2 ⟨le_rfl, Real.pi_pos.le⟩ ⟨hu0, hu1⟩
      (sub_nonneg.mpr ha1) ha0 (by ring)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, Real.sin_zero, mul_zero, zero_add,
    Real.sin_arcsin (by linarith : -1 ≤ t) ht1] at hs
  have hat : a*t ≤ 1 := calc
    a*t ≤ 1*t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 ht0
    _ ≤ 1 := by simpa using ht1
  have hau : a*Real.arcsin t ≤ Real.pi/2 := calc
    a*Real.arcsin t ≤ 1*Real.arcsin t := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ha1 hu0
    _ ≤ Real.pi/2 := by simpa using Real.arcsin_le_pi_div_two t
  apply (Real.arcsin_le_iff_le_sin
    (show a*t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 from ⟨by linarith [mul_nonneg ha0 ht0], hat⟩)
    (show a * Real.arcsin t ∈ Icc (-(Real.pi/2)) (Real.pi/2) from
      ⟨by linarith [mul_nonneg ha0 hu0, Real.pi_pos], hau⟩)).mpr
  exact hs

theorem actual_delta_geometric {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 1) (j : ℕ) :
    Delta t j ≤ Real.arcsin t * (1 / (2 : ℝ)^j) := by
  have hp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2^j := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  have ha : 1 / (2 : ℝ)^j ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 2^j)).mpr
    simpa using hp
  simpa [Delta, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
    actual_arcsin_scale_le ht.1 ht.2 (by positivity : 0 ≤ 1 / (2 : ℝ)^j) ha

theorem actual_geometric_tail_lt (R : ℕ) : ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 R, 1 / (2 : ℝ)^j < 1 := by
  by_cases h : 1 ≤ R
  · have he : (∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 R, 1 / (2 : ℝ)^j) =
        ((1/2 : ℝ) - (1/2 : ℝ)^R) / (1 - (1/2 : ℝ)) := by
      simp only [one_div, ← inv_pow]
      simpa using geom_sum_Ico' (x := (1/2 : ℝ)) (by norm_num) h
    rw [he]
    have hp : 0 < (1/2 : ℝ)^R := by positivity
    norm_num
    linarith
  · have : R = 0 := by omega
    simp [this]

theorem actual_balance_lt_five {t : ℝ} (ht0 : 0 < t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) (R : ℕ) :
    Balance R t < 5 * Real.arcsin t := by
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j (_hj : j ∈ Finset.Ico 1 R) =>
    actual_delta_geometric ⟨ht0.le, ht1⟩ j)
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum] at hs
  have hp : 0 < Real.arcsin t := Real.arcsin_pos.mpr ht0
  have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (actual_geometric_tail_lt R) hp
  unfold Balance
  linarith

theorem actual_root_delta_geometric {R : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) (j : ℕ) :
    Delta (Root R) j ≤ Delta (Root R) 0 * (1 / (2 : ℝ)^j) := by
  simpa [Delta] using actual_delta_geometric (actual_root_spec hR).1 j

theorem actual_root_balance_lt_five {R : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) :
    2 * Real.pi < 5 * Delta (Root R) 0 := by
  have hi := actual_root_interval hR
  have hpos : 0 < Root R := lt_trans (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/2) hi.1
  have hb := actual_balance_lt_five hpos hi.2.le R
  rw [(actual_root_spec hR).2] at hb
  simpa [Delta] using hb

theorem actual_root_delta_zero_gt {R : ℕ} (hR : 4 ≤ R) :
    2 * Real.pi / 5 < Delta (Root R) 0 := by
  linarith [actual_root_balance_lt_five hR]

end Reference.MD06CycleProfile

theorem actual_arcsin_derivative_lower {x : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x < 1) :
    1 + x^2/2 ≤ 1 / Real.sqrt (1-x^2) := by
  have hx : 0 < 1-x^2 := by nlinarith
  have hp := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hx.le
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).mpr
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt (1-x^2)*(1+x^2/2))^2 ≤ 1 := by
    calc
      _ = (1-x^2)*(1+x^2/2)^2 := by rw [mul_pow,hs]
      _ ≤ 1 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x^2), mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg x) (sq_nonneg (x^2))]
  have hprod : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1-x^2)*(1+x^2/2) := by positivity
  nlinarith

theorem actual_arcsin_cubic_lower {x : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ x) (h1 : x < 1) :
    x + x^3/6 ≤ Real.arcsin x := by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => Real.arcsin y-y-y^3/6
  have hd : ∀ y ∈ Icc 0 x, HasDerivAt f (1 / Real.sqrt (1-y^2)-1-y^2/2) y := by
    intro y hy
    have ha := Real.hasDerivAt_arcsin (by linarith [hy.1] : y ≠ -1) (by linarith [hy.2] : y ≠ 1)
    convert! (ha.sub (hasDerivAt_id y)).sub (((hasDerivAt_id y).pow 3).div_const 6) using 1
    simp only [id_eq]
    ring
  have hc : ContinuousOn f (Icc 0 x) := by
    unfold f
    fun_prop
  have hm : MonotoneOn f (Icc 0 x) := monotoneOn_of_deriv_nonneg (convex_Icc 0 x) hc
    (by intro y hy; exact (hd y (interior_subset hy)).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt)
    (by intro y hy; rw [(hd y (interior_subset hy)).deriv]
        have hmem := interior_subset hy
        have hh := actual_arcsin_derivative_lower hmem.1 (lt_of_le_of_lt hmem.2 h1)
        linarith)
  have he : f 0 ≤ f x := hm ⟨le_rfl,h0⟩ ⟨h0,le_rfl⟩ h0
  dsimp [f] at he
  rw [Real.arcsin_zero] at he
  linarith

theorem actual_arcsin_sixteenth_upper : Real.arcsin (1/16 : ℝ) < 1/15 := by
  have hp := Real.arcsin_pos.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/16)
  have hlt := Real.arcsin_lt_pi_div_two.mpr (by norm_num : (1/16 : ℝ) < 1)
  have ht := Real.lt_tan hp hlt
  rw [Real.tan_arcsin] at ht
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2)^2 = (255/256 : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have hn : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs : (15/16 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2) := by nlinarith
  have hd : (1/16 : ℝ) / Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2) < 1/15 := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by nlinarith : 0 < Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2))).mpr
    nlinarith
  exact ht.trans hd

theorem actual_uniform_cosine_gt_sixteenth :
    (1/16 : ℝ) < Real.sqrt (1-(Root 4)^2) := by
  let t : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1-(1/16 : ℝ)^2)
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have htsq : t^2 = (255/256 : ℝ) := by
    dsimp [t]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have ht1 : t < 1 := by nlinarith
  have ht99 : (99/100 : ℝ) < t := by nlinarith
  have ht3 : (97/100 : ℝ) < t^3 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr ht99.le) (sub_nonneg.mpr ht99.le)]
  have harc : Real.arcsin t = Real.pi/2 - Real.arcsin (1/16 : ℝ) := by
    exact (Real.arccos_eq_arcsin (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/16)).symm
  have h1 := actual_arcsin_cubic_lower (x := t/2) (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have h2 := actual_arcsin_lower (x := t/4) (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have h3 := actual_arcsin_lower (x := t/8) (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have hbalance : 2 * Real.pi < Balance 4 t := by
    norm_num [Balance,Delta,Finset.sum_Ico_eq_sum_range,Finset.sum_range_succ]
    rw [harc]
    nlinarith [actual_arcsin_sixteenth_upper, Real.pi_lt_d4]
  have hr := actual_root_spec (by omega : 4 ≤ 4)
  have hroot : Root 4 < t := by
    by_contra hh
    have hm := (actual_balance_strictMono 4).monotoneOn
      ⟨ht0,ht1.le⟩ hr.1 (le_of_not_gt hh)
    linarith [hr.2]
  have hrint := actual_root_interval (by omega : 4 ≤ 4)
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ 1-(Root 4)^2 by nlinarith [hrint.1,hrint.2])
  have hn := Real.sqrt_nonneg (1-(Root 4)^2)
  nlinarith [hrint.1]
end Reference.MD06CycleProfile

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Reference.MD06Spectral
open Reference.MD06Correction Reference.MD06Actual Matrix WithLp
open scoped BigOperators

theorem actual_laplacian_zero_eigenvalue_exists {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ i : Fin n, LaplacianEigenvalues G i = 0 := by
  classical
  let v : Configuration n := toLp 2 (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))
  have hv : v ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have he := congrArg (fun x : Configuration n => x ⟨0,hn⟩) h
    norm_num [v] at he
  have hl : LaplacianOperator G v = 0 := by
    ext i
    change ((G.lapMatrix ℝ) *ᵥ (fun _ => (1 : ℝ))) i = 0
    exact congrFun (G.lapMatrix_mulVec_const_eq_zero (R := ℝ)) i
  have he : Module.End.HasEigenvector (LaplacianOperator G) (0 : ℝ) v := by
    refine ⟨?_,hv⟩
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff]
    simpa only [zero_smul] using hl
  exact (LaplacianSymmetric G).exists_eigenvalues_eq _ (Module.End.hasEigenvalue_of_hasEigenvector he)

theorem actual_laplacian_bottom_eigenvalue_zero {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (hn : 0 < n) :
    LaplacianEigenvalues G ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ := actual_laplacian_zero_eigenvalue_exists G hn
  have hj : i ≤ (⟨n-1,by omega⟩ : Fin n) := by change i.val ≤ n-1;omega
  have hl := actual_laplacian_eigenvalues_antitone G hj
  have hp := actual_laplacian_eigenvalues_nonnegative G (⟨n-1,by omega⟩ : Fin n)
  linarith

theorem actual_connected_bottom_basis_constant {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    (hg : G.Connected) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ i j : Fin n, LaplacianEigenbasis G ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ i =
      LaplacianEigenbasis G ⟨n-1,by omega⟩ j := by
  classical
  have hq := actual_laplacian_eigenvalue_quadratic G (⟨n-1,by omega⟩ : Fin n)

    constructor

      apply Prod.ext
